title: Custom init in an Extension

docs.title: Initialization — Memberwise Initializers for Structure Types

hints: Writing an `init` inside a struct removes the free memberwise initialiser.
Put your custom `init(name:)` in an **extension** so both initialisers exist.
`extension Player { init(name: String) { self.name = name; self.number = name.unicodeScalars.reduce(0) { $0 + Int($1.value) } % 100 } }`.
